messages.author: 6fccacfc396e2a3b
messages.subject: Error in a.perm Bk model
parts:
Hi All,

I've run into the following problem running my code for a simple density estimate of leopards in a small reserve. All the other models run just fine, I just seem to be running into a problem when it comes to the g~0 = Bk model. 

The line I'm running is:

Unbaited30afit_Bk <- secr.fit(Unbaited30a, model = g0~Bk, mask = MaskUnbaited30a)

and the error message I'm getting is:

Error in aperm.default(temp, c(2, 1, 3)) : 
  'perm' is of wrong length 3 (!= 2)

Not sure what is wrong as everything else is working fine? Thanks in advance for the help!

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: Error in a.perm Bk model
parts:
I don't see any problem with
secr.fit(captdata, g0~Bk)
so it has to do with your particular dataset. I foresee issues if you have a single occasion (in which case Bk meaningless) or a single detector (as with a single search area for a polygon detector).

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: Error in a.perm Bk model
parts: Ahhh. Yes. The default with proximity data in secr >= 4.0 is to collapse to a single occasion, for speed. This precludes certain time-dependent models, including Bk. To revert to the old behaviour set details(fastproximity = FALSE). See secr-version4.pdf.

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: Error in a.perm Bk model
parts:
Further - you could call this a bug because the code should default to fastproximity = FALSE when there are learned responses, but at present these are listed as 'b', 'bk', 'B' or 'k' (I omitted the Bk model that you are using). So use the workaround in the previous post.
Murray
